scope: First original-source mallocng hot-path profile, experimental opt-in; cold paths remain guest. Benchmark preceded the default-off routing gate and exec-probe fixture addition; exact earlier binaries/source are preserved locally.

diagnostic_benchmark.limits: Three alternating samples, identical guest ELF/libc/stores on both runtimes. x86_64 development interpreter; no physical iPad or NEON timing claim. Allocator benchmark uses four threads, 96 rounds of 192 allocations/thread, cross-thread frees and sampled payload checks. Vim measures spawn to normal first cursor visibility; others use runtime guest execution seconds, excluding rootfs import.
